name: @cloudsforge/aetherholm-web
description: Aetherholm — the game client for the third Forge Worlds title: the archipelago map, city view, fleet control, battle reports and the chronicle browser.
//: @cloudsforge/ui is consumed from a sibling path because it is not published yet; see web-template's note.
